condition_completed.elb-free-tier-750-hours-15-lcus: pricing page vs FAQ difference and the July 2025 Free Tier credits fact

for_writers: Free tier: the pricing page and the FAQ disagree on NLB; both facts carry the difference in their condition; teach that the free tier changed to credits for new customers from July 15, 2025 and do not build a question on it.
GWLB endpoints: no hard limit per GWLB; AWS recommends at most 50 (elb-gwlb-faq-endpoints-per-gwlb-recommend-50).

Idle timeouts: NLB and GWLB TCP 350 s default, 60-6000 s configurable; TLS listener 350 s fixed; UDP 120 s fixed. The change date (2024-09) has no quotable snapshot (d125), so no Changed recently date for it.
Do not say a load balancer is 'Regional' as a hard fact (d088).
